pages.name: English: Anglo-Gruenfeld, Smyslov, 7.Rb1
pages.notes: Plans had White pushing a b-pawn that is on c3 (b4-b5) and rook routes Rb2-f2 and Rb3-g3. Rewritten around Rb1 against b7 and ...c5/...e5.

pages.name: King's Indian Defence
pages.notes: Plans had a ...f5-f4 route, d5/c5/b4 before e4, and a knight route via h5 or e8 to g7. Rewritten around the King's Indian and Grünfeld choices.

pages.name: English: Anglo-Queen's Indian, 4.g3
pages.notes: Plan read e4 as Black's move; American spelling. Rewritten around Re1/e4 and ...d5/...Ne4. Reviewer rejection (Black's king is not behind its fianchettoed bishop) fixed and re-reviewed.

pages.name: English: Nimzo-English, 4.g3
pages.notes: Overview called ...Bb4 a pin (the d2-pawn shields the king); plan read b4 as a move. Rewritten around Qc2/Qb3, ...Bxc3 and ...b6/...Bb7.

pages.name: English: Mikenas, Flohr, 4...d4
pages.notes: Plans had bxc3 and ...Qxf6 before the captures that allow them. Rewritten with 5.exf6 dxc3 6.bxc3 Qxf6.

pages.name: English: Mikenas, Flohr, 7.d4 c5
pages.notes: Plan had ...Bb7 pressing an e4-pawn that has gone. Rewritten around the d4-pawn and doubled c-pawns.

pages.name: English: Mikenas, 5.Nf3 Nc6
pages.notes: Plan had a knight route h6-f7. Rewritten around ...d6/...f6 against e5 and the g8-knight's return via e7 or h6. Reviewer rejection (after 7.Nxd4 the e5-pawn simply falls to ...Nxe5) fixed and re-reviewed.

pages.name: English: Mikenas, 5.Nf3 Nc6 6.d4
pages.notes: Plan had the knight route h6-f7 and e7 read as a move. Rewritten around 6...cxd4 7.Nxd4 Nxe5 and ...d6. Reviewer rejections (an unconfirmed ...d6 alternative) fixed and re-reviewed.

pages.name: English: Mikenas, 6.d4 cxd4 7.Nxd4 Nxe5
pages.notes: Plan read d6 as a move. Rewritten around Ndb5 and Bf4 against c7 and d6.

pages.name: English: King's, 2.g3 Nf6 3.Bg2 Bc5
pages.notes: Plan had a knight route Nf3-e1-d3 with no knight on f3 and the king on e1. Rewritten around Nc3/d3/b4 or e3/Nge2 against ...Bc5.
